scores.label: A
scores.note: 1 'inherently good' changes the meaning (moral goodness, not ease of life). 4 'untainted', 5 'undefiled', 7 'pure' are the moral/purity sense, wrong sense. 6 'untouched' changes the meaning. 8-10 are prepositional phrases that are ungrammatical before 'lives' ('have without flaws lives'); 10 also repeats 'with no problems'. Only 'ideal' and 'flawless' work.

scores.label: B
scores.note: 4 'without fault' is ungrammatical before 'lives'. 3 'trouble-free' is redundant with 'with no problems'; 7 'carefree' shifts to attitude; 9 'faultless' leans toward blame; 5, 6, 10 plain or slightly off. 'flawless', 'ideal', 'idyllic' are strong and first.
